periods.label: Mon 9 Nov
periods.text: Southerly 15 to 25 knots decreasing to 10 to 15 knots in the late evening. 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1.5 metres by early evening. Southeasterly 3 metres. Partly cloudy. Large and powerful surf conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.

periods.label: Tue 10 Nov
periods.text: Southwesterly 10 to 15 knots shifting northeasterly in the morning then tending northerly in the late evening. Around 1 metre, decreasing below 0.5 metres during the morning, then increasing to below 1 metre around midday. Southeasterly 3 to 4 metres, decreasing to 2.5 to 3 metres during the morning. Sunny. Large and powerful surf conditions are expected to be hazardous for coastal activities such as crossing bars by boat and rock fishing.

periods.label: Wed 11 Nov

periods.text: South to southwesterly 10 to 15 knots, reaching up to 20 knots offshore south of Cape Byron in the late morning and early afternoon. periods.label: Wed 11 Nov
periods.text: Northerly 15 to 25 knots. 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1 to 2 metres offshore south of Cape Byron. Southerly 1.5 to 2.5 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning. Mostly sunny. 60% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon and evening.
